newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sept coffee exports down due to ICMS delay.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sept coffee exports down due to ICMS delay.

text.p: Brazil's September exports of coffee, ground and in beans, of 1.14 million bags were below August levels as companies held back ahead of a state export tax exemption, the Brazilian Federation of Coffee Exporters said.
But any shortfall due to the scrapping of the tax which finally took effect in the middle of last month should be made up in October shipments, said president Oswaldo Aranha.
The September figure is not only below an adjusted August total of 1.56 million bags but is also less than the 1.28 million bags shipped in September last year.

According to the Brazilian Soluble Coffee Association (ABICS), soluble coffee exports last month reached 172,448 bags, giving a total of 1.31 million bags of coffee exports, according to today's bulletin from the Rio de Janeiro Coffee Center.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
